arStrings.szText: "What just happened? Who are you, spirit?"
I am Pheonos of Atanos. That creature you slew was what became of my beloved sister and my murderer, Koscythia.
You have seen our past and beheld the truth—my sister was a monster long before she was twisted into this wretched form. Now, by your hand, I am avenged. Thank you.
The blade you carry is yours now. My blood stains it no longer. May it defend you from the darkness to come.
I have long walked the sunless path, and seen much of this land. I would grant you all I know before I fall away from the circle of this frail world forever.
Ask me what you will, friend.
